text: {"label": "Racism, Policing, and Criminal Justice","definition": "Behavioral and systems analyses of racism, bias, oppression, and violence, especially in policing and criminal justice, including anti-racist interventions, restorative justice, and calls for behavior analysis to become anti-racist.","distinct_from_neighbours": "Focuses on racism, injustice, and policing rather than general social behavior and cooperation, the philosophy and history of behaviorism, or qualitative research methods."}
